courses.title: Mentorship & Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring by phone or video over six weeks to six months, starting with a free discovery call. Cindy helps clients build daily habits and new ways of seeing their situation, with attention to body, relationships, happiness and spiritual life, drawing on her own path through hard times.
courses.price: Discovery package $765; Foundation package $895; Expansion package $1695

courses.title: Healing Sound Bath Journey
courses.description: A monthly 75-minute session at Bluestem Yoga in Lawrence, Kansas. Cindy opens with a short guided meditation and gentle movement, then plays a 45-minute soundscape of singing bowls, chimes, voice and viola while the group rests.
